summary.text: Natalie Higgins is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Worcester District since January 2017 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Higgins took office on January 4, 2017, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and the Judiciary, Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy, and Ways and Means joint committees, and served as vice chair of the Public Service Joint Committee.
